recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast promotional graphic featuring a centered female portrait against a white background populated with vertical columns of metallic gold discs. A massive, dark diagonal band cuts across the top third, housing oversized, stylized white lettering, while secondary information is anchored in the bottom left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait overlaps the background gold elements and the dark diagonal band.
Diagonal band creates a dynamic tension against the vertical columns of circles.
Gold accents in the background coordinate with the yellow-gold text in the bottom corner.
High-key white background provides maximum contrast for the black clothing and dark graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Vertical columns of gold metallic circles with radial gradients.
A 20-30 degree upward diagonal dark band.
Subject positioned from waist-up, hands on hips.
Strict color palette of Black, White, and Gold/Yellow.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame from the waist up, scaled to dominate the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large diagonal dark band at the top acts as the primary visual anchor and entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left diagonal, follows the text downward to the subject's face, then drops to the bottom-left text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White negative space is used between columns of gold discs to maintain clarity and prevent visual clutter.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (diagonal band, subject's clothing, and primary name text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Yellow (background discs and secondary metadata text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between pure white and deep black, with mid-tone metallic gold providing texture.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with occasional character overlaps
Sheared or slanted to match the 25-degree angle of the background band
Uniform stroke weight in secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized initial characters that break the boundaries of the containing band
Lowercase 'the' nested above the primary display word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between massive slanted display type and stable, upright geometric sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean lines for the display text.
Classic geometric feel that matches the circular motifs in the background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a woman with blonde hair in a black shirt, centered against a white background. Behind her, vertical columns of metallic gold discs with radial highlights. A thick black diagonal band runs across the top third of the image from bottom-left to top-right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive white geometric sans-serif text inside the black diagonal band, slanted to match the angle. Add a three-line block of text in the bottom-left corner using a mix of black and gold sans-serif fonts.

verificationChecks: Text in the diagonal band is slanted exactly to the band's angle.
Gold discs have a metallic, 3D radial gradient effect.
Subject's hair and shoulders overlap the black band.

adjustableVariables: Density of the gold disc columns
Color of the secondary text (Gold vs Black)
mustRedesign: Specific show logos or trademarked branding
Exact facial features of the specific artist

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like edges on all graphics
Consistent lighting on the subject and background elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the diagonal band does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the gold discs appear as a pattern, not random clutter.
Verify the high-contrast black/white/gold palette is maintained.
Confirm the text hierarchy clearly distinguishes the name from the metadata.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key studio portrait with a dynamic diagonal graphic element and a repeating geometric background pattern, using a restricted three-color palette for a bold, commercial look.
